components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it is stored and used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility (the flat form); on output it is the composed,
            normalized address - the normalized addressLine1 with a single space and
            the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized with the same
            rules (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type
            abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal
            address (unit, apartment, etc.). Normalized like addressLine1 and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall inside that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            present the server derives the owner's 'ageBand' from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-only flag. When true, the owner may join an existing household
            (an owner with the same last name and postcode) instead of being rejected as a
            household duplicate; it is then admitted as a declared member and is not flagged
            as a possible duplicate. Not persisted and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:

        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:

      description: A pet owner.

          properties:

              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.

            displayName:

            salutation:
              title: Salutation

                the last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61412345678' becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable, deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same
                household, computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode'. Owners with the same last name and postcode
                therefore share it automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, computed at creation. Starts at 0;
                adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; adds 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints at creation - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from their locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the moment it was created (a high-volume
                sign-up day); false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference

              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against

              type: string

              readOnly: true

              type: string

              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

              type: boolean

            possibleDuplicateOf:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When present it is stored and used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for
            backward compatibility (the flat form); on output it is the composed,
            normalized address - the normalized addressLine1 with a single space and
            the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized with the same
            rules (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand common street-type
            abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal
            address (unit, apartment, etc.). Normalized like addressLine1 and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall inside that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional; when
            present the server derives the owner's 'ageBand' from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-only flag. When true, the owner may join an existing household
            (an owner with the same last name and postcode) instead of being rejected as a
            household duplicate; it is then admitted as a declared member and is not flagged
            as a possible duplicate. Not persisted and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the honorific 'title'
                followed by a single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just
                the last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61412345678' becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit year of the registrationDate's fiscal year (the
                fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is identified by the calendar year in
                which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June
                and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends, so a registrationDate
                in July 2025 to June 2026 yields 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customerCode (non-digit separators are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable, deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same
                household, computed as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode'. Owners with the same last name and postcode
                therefore share it automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, computed at creation. Starts at 0;
                adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a
                household of 3 or more; adds 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints at creation - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from their locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this
                owner's registration date at the moment it was created (a high-volume
                sign-up day); false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their
                fields; 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

              title: Age band

                'registrationDate'; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 and
                'SENIOR' from 65. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key

## What I did

The spec required moving date-derived values onto a fiscal-year basis (fiscal year starts 1 July), exposing a new `fiscalYear` field as `FY<YY>`, and changing two existing behaviours. I made the fiscal-year rule a single source of truth so every consumer agrees.

**New `mapper/FiscalYear.java`** — derives fiscal-year values from a date. The fiscal year runs 1 July–30 June and is identified by the calendar year it *ends* (standard FY notation, e.g. 1 Jul 2025–30 Jun 2026 → `FY26`). It exposes `ordinal`, `yearSegment`, `label` (`FY<YY>`), and `elapsed` (whole fiscal years between two dates).

**Behaviour changes:**
1. **Membership identifier's year segment** (`OwnerMapper` + `LogOwnerAudit`) — `<customerCode>-M<YY>` now uses the fiscal-year two-digit year instead of the calendar year.
2. **Tenure** (`MembershipLevel`) — the +3 points now trigger on at least one *elapsed fiscal year* rather than a >365-day window. A freshly created owner still has zero tenure (same fiscal year), preserving the "fresh owner tops out at 5 points" invariant.

**New field:** `fiscalYear` added to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml` (so the generated `OwnerDto` gains it), mapped from the owner's persisted business-day-adjusted registration date.

I derived `fiscalYear` (and the membership year segment) from `owner.getRegistrationDate()`, which `ApplyRegistrationDate` already stores business-day-adjusted — so the fiscal year is correctly computed from the adjusted date. I verified consistency in the run: an owner registered 2026-08-11 got `membershipNumber=...-M27` and would report `fiscalYear=FY27` (Aug 2026 falls in the fiscal year ending 2027).

I also updated the affected OpenAPI descriptions (`membershipNumber`, `membershipPoints`) to match the new semantics.
